Bad Sketches

The two 4-click sketches whose own line passes 0.07 m and 0.04 m from the center gate's west post. Pin at sigma 0 and 0.5; plain pi0 with the command in the source and the velocity projected off the command subspace by (1 - s) per Euler step (s = 0 exact carry); SDEdit at t0 0.5. Top: mixed-data checkpoints (gmsig3 / scratch3). Bottom: real-only checkpoints. 5 trials each.
